QuestInfo.name: Letting Go
QuestInfo.0: The girl says she remembers burying something important underneath the maple tree, and starts digging. Opening her old #btime capsule#k, she becomes distraught and deeply confused to discover that its contents have aged significantly. What could you possibly say to make the truth any less difficult?
